The '''Gallinore system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Gallinore Reach]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Interior Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system received its name from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gallinore]] which was situated within it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Gallinore system's first and only appearance was in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' on page 136.<ref name="TEA" />
